title: ATTACHED FORM NO. 1 — APPLICATION TO OPERATE OUTSOURCED POST OFFICE COUNTER SERVICES
full_text:
ATTACHED FORM NO. 1 — APPLICATION TO OPERATE OUTSOURCED POST OFFICE COUNTER SERVICES
[Enforcement Rules of the Act Concerning the Contracting Out of Post Office Counter Operations; amended December 5, 2024]

APPLICATION IDENTIFIERS

| Application receipt number | Date of receipt | Processing period |
|---|---|---|
| __________________________ | __________________________ | __________________________ |

APPLICANT'S INFORMATION

| Item | Details |
|---|---|
| Business name (corporate name) | __________________________ |
| Business registration number | __________________________ |
| Applicant's name (representative's name) | __________________________ |
| Date of birth | __________________________ |
| Location of business establishment (office) | __________________________ |
| Type of business | __________________________ |
| Floor area of office to be used for outsourced operations | __________ square metres |
| Telephone number | __________________________ |

APPLICATION DECLARATION

Pursuant to Article 3 of the Act Concerning the Contracting Out of Post Office Counter Operations and Article 4 of its Enforcement Rules, I hereby apply to operate the post office counter services on an outsourced basis as stated above.

Date: Year ______  Month ______  Day ______

Applicant: __________________________  (Signature or seal)

To: Head of the Regional Postal Administration

DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED BY THE APPLICANT (REPRESENTATIVE)

Applicants falling under Article 3 (2) 1 or 2 of the Act:
1. A sketch map showing the proposed location of the post office to be operated under contract.
2. A floor plan of the office proposed for use as the contracted post office.

Applicants falling under any of Article 3 (2) 3 through 6 of the Act:
1. Documents establishing that the applicant is a person qualifying under any of Article 3 (2) 3 through 6 of the Act.
2. A sketch map showing the proposed location of the post office to be operated under contract.
3. A floor plan of the office proposed for use as the contracted post office.
4. If the office intended for use as the contracted post office is leased: a copy of the lease agreement.

Application fee: None.

MATTERS TO BE VERIFIED BY THE RESPONSIBLE PUBLIC OFFICIAL

1. Certificate of corporate registration (only where the applicant is a corporation).
2. Certificate of business registration (meaning a business registration certificate with the resident registration number omitted; the same meaning applies throughout this form).
3. Certificate of registered particulars of the building intended for use as the contracted post office (only where an application under Article 4 (1) 2 of the Enforcement Rules of the Act Concerning the Contracting Out of Post Office Counter Operations is received).

CONSENT TO JOINT USE OF ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION

I consent to verification of my business registration certificate through the shared use of administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act in connection with the processing of this application.

* If the applicant does not consent, the applicant must submit the relevant document directly.

Applicant (representative): __________________________  (Signature or seal)

PROCESSING PROCEDURE

| Step | Action | Party responsible |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Preparation of application | Applicant |
| 2 | Receipt of application | Processing institution — Post office having jurisdiction |
| 3 | Examination and review | Processing institution — Regional Postal Administration |
| 4 | Conclusion of contract for outsourced operations | Processing institution — Regional Postal Administration |

Form size: 210 mm × 297 mm; ordinary paper, 80 g/m².
